newsitem.title: USA: Weston has NY Power contract.
newsitem.headline: Weston has NY Power contract.

text.p: Roy F. Weston Inc said it has a New York Power Authority contract to provide environmental risk assessment and asbestos abatement planning services.

The company said it will do this as part of an "upfront" team that, over the next two years, will implement air quality improvements and energy efficiency upgrades throughout the state under the new Electrotechnologies and Coal Conversion Pilot Programs, financed by the Authority with 10-year repayment, and the Clean Air for Schools Program, funded by the recently enacted $1.75-billion New York State Environmental Quality Bond Act.
Particularly targeted is the conversion of antiquated coal-fired boilers to cleaner-burning gas furnaces.
"These are important as over 200 of (New York) City's schools are heated by their original coal-fired boilers," the company explained.
